description: Append documents (rows, as JSON objects keyed by column name) to a table; one call is one commit. If the table has a vector index and a document omits the vector, the server embeds its text column (a local model, no API key). Send tens of rows per call; for a whole corpus use the infino CLI or an SDK.

documents.description: Rows to append, as JSON objects keyed by column name.

name: infino_add_documents
title: Add documents to an Infino table
